generate_grpc_prefixed_packages: run the script to generate all grpc-prefixed PyPI packages using Jinja2 templates
generate_package: generate a single grpc-prefixed package from a PackageMeta dataclass and Jinja2 templates
clean_build_artifacts: clean the build and dist directories by removing them with shutil.rmtree
create_package_meta: create a PackageMeta dataclass with name, name_long, destination_package, and version fields
render_jinja2_templates: render Jinja2 templates from the templates directory using PackageMeta data as context
